node.build: Hydra build 15172667 (evaluation 126863): cardano-node-11.1.1-linux.tar.gz, static, reporting version 11.1.1 at this revision

setup: One stake pool, three DReps, no constitutional committee, testnet magic 42, 200-slot epochs of 0.1 s, generated with cardano-testnet create-env.
Node configuration adds ExperimentalHardForksEnabled and TestDijkstraHardForkAtEpoch 2 to the generated DijkstraGenesisFile and ExperimentalProtocolsEnabled.

The test fork trigger moves the chain into Dijkstra at epoch 2 but leaves the protocol version at 10; two hard-fork initiation actions, ratified by the DReps and the pool, raised it to 11 and then 12 before any transaction or tool check ran.
Every check below ran against protocol version 12 except the Ogmios and Kupo runs and the handshake probe, which do not depend on it.

The pallas-chain-sync, pallas-transactions, cml-decoding and js-sdk-transactions checks ran on 2026-10-22 against a fresh devnet from the same recipe, after the other seven checks reproduced there unchanged (same results, error messages and decoder offsets; only slots and hashes differ).

checks.title: The 11.2 integration node forks to Dijkstra and reaches protocol version 12
checks.summary: The chain entered Dijkstra at the configured epoch and two governance hard forks raised the protocol version to 12. The protocol-parameter query returns 54 parameters: the 31 Conway ones plus the 23 Dijkstra additions (Leios, Peras, reference-script limits, minimum pool margin and maximum pledge leverage).

checks.title: Which Conway-built transactions the node accepts after the fork
checks.summary: Conway-built transactions (four-element, is_valid true) are re-decoded as Dijkstra and accepted for a payment, a registration with a deposit, a body with required_signers (read as a key-hash guard, whose witness is still required) and metadata. A Conway deposit-less registration (certificate type 0) is rejected as an era mismatch, and the Dijkstra decoder itself refuses that certificate. cardano-cli builds Dijkstra transactions as three-element arrays, and the mempool hands every transaction back in that form with its id unchanged. All accepted transactions reached a block.

results.note: Only the deposit-less registration was exercised.
Only a Conway key-hash required signer was exercised.

checks.title: The node's Dijkstra block: non-segregated body, ten-field Babbage header
checks.summary: The first Dijkstra block is [header, block_body] with block_body [transactions, nil, nil], as the change register says. Its header body still has the ten Babbage fields, ending in protocol version [12, 0]: the shared Praos header encoder at the target ledger revision writes that header for Dijkstra, so the CDDL's header_version_info and two Leios fields are not what the node emits. gouroboros v0.213.0 and v0.213.9 require the twelve-field CDDL header and stop at the first Dijkstra block after decoding all 20 Conway blocks.

results.note: The node emits the ten-field header with protocol_version.

checks.title: Ogmios v7.0.0 and Kupo v2.12 stop at the first Dijkstra block
checks.summary: Both connect and know a Dijkstra era, but their chain-sync decoder rejects the node's Dijkstra blocks and the process exits. Kupo indexed every Conway block up to slot 393 before failing on the first block of epoch 2 (slot 400 onwards). Ogmios exits from its own health chain-sync, so none of its other protocols can be reached on this node.

checks.title: gouroboros cannot tell the era of an ordinary Dijkstra transaction
checks.summary: DetermineTransactionType places a three-element transaction in Dijkstra only if its body has key 23, 25 or 26 or a credential guard, and the Shelley-to-Mary decoders it tries next reject Dijkstra bodies, so it returns "unknown transaction type" for six of the seven mempool transactions; the one with a key-hash guard is placed. Forcing the Dijkstra decoder decodes all seven. LocalTxMonitor's NextTx drops the era id the node sends, so a mempool reader cannot pass the era instead. txtop's mempool view and cardano-node-api's mempool listing and transaction submission all go through this call.

results.note: Decoding path exercised through the probe, which runs txtop's extractTx calls.

checks.title: txtop and cardano-node-api before and after the gouroboros upgrade
checks.summary: At their pins both are refused at the handshake. txtop builds unchanged on gouroboros v0.213.0 and shows the mempool. cardano-node-api builds on no v0.213.x release as is: adder v0.44.0, v0.45.0 and adder's main branch (still on gouroboros v0.209.0) fail on gouroboros's certificate amount and epoch types, and its own code needs four call-site changes for the new TxInfo arguments and integer types; on v0.213.0 the selected plutigo also breaks gouroboros itself. With those changes made locally (patches in the recipe) it answers era, tip, protocol-parameter and mempool-size queries on Dijkstra, and decodes a UTxO set holding outputs and a token minted in Dijkstra transactions, which settles the question its Babbage output type left open.

checks.title: Pallas cannot decode the node's Dijkstra blocks in any revision
checks.summary: Chain-sync from origin through pallas-network, decoding each block with MultiEraBlock::decode as Oura, Dolos and cncli do. All 21 Conway blocks decode in every revision; no Dijkstra block does. v1.4.0 and main do not know era tag 8. The dijkstra branch decodes Dijkstra only behind its unstable feature, and its HeaderBody requires the twelve fields of the target CDDL (protocol_version, then block_body_contains_leios_cert and eb_announcement), while the node emits ten. That twelve-field header has been in Pallas's Dijkstra primitives since they were introduced (#799, 2026-09-16), including v1.4.0. Pallas PRs #800 and #817 merged into the dijkstra branch, not main.
observed: v1.4.0 (aef0b5a0) and main (e6c38ac5): era tag 7: 21 blocks decoded; era tag 8: 0 decoded, every block failed: Unknown CBOR structure: 820882828a1519019a…

dijkstra branch (e7ea1726, unstable): era tag 7: 21 blocks decoded; era tag 8: 0 decoded, every block failed: Invalid CBOR structure: missing value at index 10 (HeaderBody::block_body_contains_leios_cert) in map or array starting at position 4

checks.title: Pallas decodes mempool Dijkstra transactions only on its dijkstra branch, and only when told the era
checks.summary: The seven transactions captured from the mempool (three-element Dijkstra mempool form, including the four Conway-built ones the node translated) were decoded with MultiEraTx::decode, which detects the era, and on the dijkstra branch also with decode_for_era(Dijkstra). Era detection fails on all seven in every revision: by design it recognises Dijkstra only by the four-element block form. Naming the era on the dijkstra branch decodes all seven.

results.note: Only through decode_for_era(Era::Dijkstra) with the unstable feature; MultiEraTx::decode still fails.

checks.title: cardano-js-sdk 0.47.1 decodes and re-encodes plain Dijkstra transactions
checks.summary: Serialization.Transaction.fromCbor, toCore() and toCbor() on the seven mempool transactions and the eight text envelopes. All fifteen decode, re-encode byte for byte and give the transaction id computed independently from the mempool bytes. Only payments, a deposit registration, a required signer and metadata were exercised: guards, sub-transactions, direct deposits, balance intervals and PlutusV4 were not, and the SDK has no block codec.
